description: Simplified road networks, Europe and China is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Juste Raimbault. Road networks from OpenStreetMap, simplified into graphs with a minimal resolution (links between population raster cells). postgresql (postgis) dumps. Coverage: continental (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2018. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
